closeout.summary: Audited the current Passport email/distribution path. Published Marketplace machines can send a real rendered IXI Machine Passport email through AWS SES, but the implementation is not yet commercial-grade for every machine object/site-wide use.
closeout.before: Status was unclear: Passport email existed in pieces, but there was no verified answer on whether any machine across Marketplace/private/AOS/auction could be sent commercially.
closeout.after: Confirmed current capability and exact gaps. Current /api/marketplace/share-email sends a rendered Passport HTML email through SES to 1-5 validated recipients with optional note, same-origin checks, request IDs, idempotency keys, rate limiting and delivery response. However, its authoritative loader only accepts published non-deleted Sharetribe Marketplace listings, so private/AOS/auction/non-Sharetribe machine objects cannot use this path. Delivery idempotency/rate state is process-local in-memory Map rather than distributed durable storage. Reply-To is static configuration, not per authenticated sender. SES Simple message contains HTML/text Passport presentation but no literal attached Passport/PDF artifact.
risks: Calling this site-wide today would overstate capability because non-public/non-Sharetribe machine objects cannot be resolved by loadDistributionListing.
In-memory rate/idempotency controls can reset or diverge across serverless instances and are not enterprise durable.
Static Reply-To does not preserve sender-specific commercial communication/audit behavior.
No literal attached Passport/PDF artifact is generated by the current SES Simple send path.
notes: Commercial completion plan: create one canonical PassportDistributionService that resolves a machine by stable IXI object/passport identity independent of card family/source; enforce access policy per public/private/auction object; build the same Passport presentation from canonical machine data; send through SES; persist send attempts/idempotency/rate/audit records in DynamoDB; record sender identity and Reply-To policy; expose one distribution command to Marketplace, AOS/private, Auction and Passport surfaces; add optional generated Passport attachment/download artifact if the product requirement remains 'actual Passport file on device'; certify with real email sends from at least one Marketplace, one private/AOS and one auction machine plus failure/retry/idempotency tests.
No production source code was changed by this review Ticket.
tests: Production runtime log search over last 24h found no marketplace_distribution_email events, so live end-user send traffic was not independently proven by logs during this audit.

agentRating.note: High-confidence source audit with exact capability boundary and commercial completion plan; no code changes were authorized or needed for this review Ticket.
